entries.title: Cited works come with a short checked note
entries.body: Works an article cites can carry a note of one or two sentences on what each is about, written from that work's published abstract. Each sentence is checked against the abstract before it is shown, and you can open the quotes that support it; where nothing could be checked, no note appears. Notes show in the Bibliography list, in the card when you point at a citation, in shared articles, in Chat and in exports. The privacy page says what is looked up and sent.

entries.title: Front and back matter fold into labelled lines
entries.body: In your own articles, the matter around the main text, such as the title and authors, the abstract and the references, now folds away into compact labelled lines, each with a count and an information button. Open one to read that stretch, and Structure marks which parts are folded so you can still see there is an abstract. This replaces the Show authors and details button.

entries.title: Jumping to an item centres and flashes it
entries.body: When you jump to an entry in the Bibliography, Glossary, Ideas or Claims list, the list scrolls it towards the middle and briefly highlights it, so you can tell which row you landed on. The note saying how many items are hidden is shorter, leaving more room for the list.

entries.title: Take a quiz mark into Chat
entries.body: A Discuss this in chat button sits beside each finished quiz mark. It opens a new chat with the question, your answer and the mark already quoted, and waits for you to write before anything is sent.

entries.title: Quiz marks on long articles finish properly
entries.body: On long articles, marking a quiz answer could stop partway and be refused. The AI now has enough room to finish its mark.

entries.title: Authors and year found for unmarked pages
entries.body: Some web pages, such as certain arXiv papers, do not mark up their authors, so the article showed no authors or year. Where the page's own address or DOI matches a published record with the same title, the authors, year and journal now come from that record. Authors a page does list are never replaced.

entries.title: Highlight button stays clear of the iPhone menu
entries.body: On an iPhone, selecting words with a finger could put the phone's own menu over the Highlight or comment button. The button now sits at the edge of the screen, still in line with the end of your selection, where the menu does not reach.
